# Sea rock: a squashed, jittered icosphere, half under the water. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.8 --location 0 0 0.1
scale 1.3 1.0 0.9
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 31
mode object
material new Rock --base-color 0.133 0.137 0.137
shade flat
export rock.glb
